standard.summary: torch.compile 路线下限制 AOT partitioner 保留的激活量：取值 (0,1] 表示相对完整保存的比例，超出预算的中间量在反传时重算。0 = 关闭。
standard.effect: 开启后 torch._functorch.config.activation_memory_budget 被设为该值，编译图的前向只保存预算内「最值得保存」的激活，其余反传重算，峰值显存下降、反传变慢。梯度检查点开启时本项被跳过。
standard.whenToUse: 使用 torch.compile 且关闭梯度检查点、想要比「全存激活」省显存但又不想付出完整 grad-ckpt 代价的中间档位（如 0.7~0.9）。
standard.avoidWhen: gradient_checkpointing 开启时（后端主动跳过：checkpoint 重算与重划分图可能分歧，且 grad-ckpt 已把保存激活压到最低，预算冗余）；非 compile 执行路线本项无效。

standard_en.summary: On the torch.compile path, caps how many activations the AOT partitioner keeps: a value in (0,1] is the fraction relative to saving everything, and intermediates beyond the budget are recomputed during the backward pass. 0 turns it off.
standard_en.effect: Once set, torch._functorch.config.activation_memory_budget takes this value: the compiled graph's forward saves only the most worth-saving activations inside the budget and recomputes the rest on the backward pass, so peak VRAM drops and the backward gets slower. The setting is skipped while gradient checkpointing is on.
standard_en.whenToUse: With torch.compile and gradient checkpointing off, when you want a middle level -- 0.7 to 0.9, say -- that saves more than saving every activation without paying the full grad-ckpt cost.
standard_en.avoidWhen: While gradient_checkpointing is on the backend skips it deliberately: checkpoint recompute and graph re-partitioning can disagree, and grad-ckpt has already pushed saved activations to the minimum, so the budget is redundant. It also has no effect on non-compile execution paths.

advanced.principle: AOT Autograd 的 min-cut partitioner 在「保存激活」与「反传重算」之间求最小割；budget<1.0 时给保存集合加上体积约束，优先重算重计算成本最低的中间量，是 PyTorch 官方认可的显存-速度连续调节杆。
advanced.intervention: runtime_optimizations_attention_plan.py 读取配置进 plan；runtime_optimizations_attention_apply.py 在 compile 生效前调用 dynamo_budget.apply_activation_memory_budget(budget, gradient_checkpointing=...)，越界（>1.0）忽略、与 grad-ckpt 冲突时记录跳过原因。
advanced.expectedImpact: 预算越小显存越省、反传越慢；0.8 左右常能以个位数百分比的速度代价换取可观激活显存下降。
advanced.tradeoffs: 只作用于被 compile 的子图；与 unsloth/selective checkpoint 等其它激活管理机制不叠加使用更易归因。失败时降级为警告不阻塞编译。

advanced_en.principle: AOT Autograd's min-cut partitioner finds a minimum cut between "save activation" and "recompute in backward"; with budget<1.0 a size constraint is added to the save set, preferring to recompute intermediates with the lowest recompute cost — PyTorch's officially sanctioned VRAM-vs-speed continuum knob.
advanced_en.intervention: runtime_optimizations_attention_plan.py reads the config into the plan; runtime_optimizations_attention_apply.py calls dynamo_budget.apply_activation_memory_budget(budget, gradient_checkpointing=...) before compile takes effect — out-of-range (>1.0) values are ignored and conflicts with grad-ckpt are logged with the skip reason.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Smaller budgets save more VRAM and slow backward; around 0.8 often trades a single-digit-percent speed cost for a substantial activation-VRAM drop.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Only acts on the compiled subgraph; avoid stacking with unsloth/selective checkpoint and other activation-management mechanisms for easier attribution. On failure it degrades to a warning without blocking compilation.
advanced_en.codePath: dynamo_budget.py:apply_activation_memory_budget (torch._functorch.config.activation_memory_budget); applied in runtime_optimizations_attention_apply.py; defined in configs_performance.py
